data.name: Epoxy flooring preparation and maintenance
data.description: What epoxy flooring is good for, where it fails outdoors, and what to use instead on a Melbourne driveway or patio. Preparation, maintenance and exterior coating alternatives.

data.name: Epoxy Flooring and Coatings Melbourne | Where It Works | Prime Exteriors
data.description: What epoxy flooring is good for, where it fails outdoors, and what to use instead on a Melbourne driveway or patio. Preparation, maintenance and exterior coating alternatives.

acceptedAnswer.text:
No, and we would say no even if we installed it. Standard epoxy is not UV stable. On an open Melbourne driveway it chalks and yellows within a couple of summers and then has to be ground off, which is a much worse job than sealing would have been.

What you probably want is a colour seal, which gets the same look and is built for the outside.

mainEntity.name: What about polyaspartic or polyurea instead?

acceptedAnswer.text:
They are genuinely more UV stable than epoxy and they cure fast, which is why they have taken over the garage floor market. They are still a coatings trade and still an installer’s job, not ours.

Outdoors they also still sit on top of the slab, so the moisture question does not go away. On an exterior slab a penetrating sealer sidesteps the whole problem.

mainEntity.name: Can you clean an epoxy floor that has gone dull?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes, and that is work we do. A dull epoxy floor is usually a film of detergent residue and fine scratching rather than a worn coating, and neutral chemistry with the right pad brings a lot of it back.

Where the coating itself has worn through, cleaning will not fix it and we will say so rather than selling you a visit.

mainEntity.name: Do you prepare slabs for a coatings installer?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Yes. Degreasing, stain removal and cleaning back to sound concrete is exactly the work we do, and it is the step most often skimped on before a coating goes down.

Grinding and shot blasting are the installer’s own preparation and they will want to do that themselves, which is fair enough.

mainEntity.name: Is epoxy good for a warehouse hardstand outside the roller door?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Not outside it. Inside the door, yes. The transition at the door line is where most of these floors start failing, because that strip gets sun, water and the most traffic all at once.

The apron outside is better sealed than coated. Car parks and hardstands covers how that is handled.
